name: Subhakrit Rajbhandari
headline: Cybersecurity Penetration Tester
intro: A passionate cybersecurity professional specializing in Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), helping organizations strengthen their security posture through comprehensive security assessments across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, thick clients, and network infrastructure. Experienced in assessing enterprise applications for fintech companies, banking institutions, and international organizations while delivering actionable remediation guidance aligned with industry best practices.
